state.task: Resolve the running direction of single platform escalators in the Busan Station twin with facts found after judgment 007. Typed judgment only; advisory.

new_facts.south_wells: Five wells at the south edge of the 2F concourse, behind a portal and glass balustrades named '남측 게이트' (south gate), each with one escalator beside stairs descending to platforms 1, 3·4, 5·6, 8·9 and 10·11.
new_facts.north_wells: Five wells on the north deck over the tracks, signed '↓ 1', '3·4', '↓ 5·6', '↓ 8·9', '↓ 10·11 타는 곳', each with one escalator beside stairs; the north end of the concourse carries a 'Gate ExitBoard' panel; one mid-deck well to platform 10·11 carries a '나가는 곳' (way out) sign.
new_facts.train: The KTX set stands at platform 5·6 between both wells; departing passengers come from the concourse, arriving passengers leave toward exits and the plaza.
new_facts.judgment_007: all_up_way_out 0.72 when the gate/deck distinction was unknown.

escalator_directions.instructions: Which running directions should the single escalators take?

criteria.south_down_north_up: South-gate wells run down to the platforms (boarding side); north-deck wells and the mid-deck way-out well run up (arrival side). Both have stairs for the other direction.
criteria.all_up_way_out: Every platform escalator runs up; everyone going down uses stairs.
criteria.south_up_north_down: South wells up, north wells down.
